title: Chicken pepper karahi
summary: Chicken pepper karahi is a indian dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice skinless chicken thigh fillets and red peppers before the pan is hot. Chicken pepper karahi is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry skinless chicken thigh fillets until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add red peppers and green peppers, return skinless chicken thigh fillets, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Chicken pepper karahi before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
